name: Futagoza Jemiminiya
source:
The prince with two personalities, they’re the clever older brother and the rascal younger brother Gemini.

The wise and sophisticated older brother, Gemimi, and the mishievious younger brother, Miminia, share the same body. Although the prince sometimes seems to be talking to himself, it is actually just the conversation between the brothers.

Gemimi is logical and quick-witted, but can’t stand anything unreasonable. Miminia is curious but has trouble focusing on one thing. They both follow the shifting trends of Earth and of their own hearts.
